name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the soft preference "Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards" requires door_open at or after each has_door_key, i.e. a Response(has_door_key, door_open). The candidate uses RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open), which also allows door_open to occur before the first has_door_key. Change the clause to Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft; the other clauses are correct.
